mapper.sql: CASE t.partner_type WHEN 'CUSTOMER' THEN c.name WHEN 'SUPPLIER' THEN s.name ELSE t.partner_name END
LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON t.partner_type = 'CUSTOMER' AND c.id = t.partner_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON t.partner_type = 'SUPPLIER' AND s.id = t.partner_id

SELECT t.*, AS partner_label, CONCAT(a.code, ' ', a.name) AS account_name, d.name AS dept_name, v.voucher_no, v.status AS voucher_status, cu.nickname AS create_by_name, fu.nickname AS confirm_by_name FROM fin_io_doc t
LEFT JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = t.dept_id LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = t.voucher_id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.id = t.create_by LEFT JOIN sys_user fu ON fu.id = t.confirm_by
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT i.doc_id, g.name AS category_name FROM fin_io_doc_item i JOIN fin_io_category g ON g.id = i.category_id WHERE i.doc_id IN #{id}

SELECT i.*, g.name AS category_name, g.account_id, CONCAT(a.code, ' ', a.name) AS account_name FROM fin_io_doc_item i JOIN fin_io_category g ON g.id = i.category_id LEFT JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = g.account_id WHERE i.doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY i.id

SELECT g.id AS "categoryId", g.name AS "categoryName", t.direction AS "direction", a.code AS "accountCode", a.name AS "accountName", COUNT(*) AS "count", SUM(i.amount) AS "amount" FROM fin_io_doc_item i JOIN fin_io_doc t ON t.id = i.doc_id JOIN fin_io_category g ON g.id = i.category_id LEFT JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = g.account_id WHERE t.status = #{status} AND t.doc_date >= #{begin} AND t.doc_date <= #{end} AND t.direction = #{direction} GROUP BY g.id, g.name, t.direction, a.code, a.name, g.sort ORDER BY t.direction, g.sort, g.id
